items.title: Can I change my seat after booking?
items.description: Yes, you can change your seat after booking through Manage My Booking, subject to availability and fare rules.

items.title: Are seats free or paid?
items.description: Some seats are complimentary based on your fare type, while preferred or extra-legroom seats may require an additional fee.

items.title: Is seat selection available for infant booking ?
items.description: Seat selection for bookings with infants depends on aircraft configuration and available seating policies at the time of travel.

items.title: Is in-flight entertainment available for children?
items.description: In-flight entertainment options for children vary by aircraft. Where available, family-friendly content is offered onboard.

textWithBlobImage.title: A More Enjoyable Flight for Little Travelers
textWithBlobImage.description: Travel moments are more beautiful when our children are happy, that's why we designed our onboard children's toys to add a fun and entertaining mood during flights, ensuring they have a pleasant time filled with laughter and joy.

callUs.upperText: Customer Support Hotline: Open from 9 AM to 9 PM
callUs.bottomText: Call us anytime for urgent assistance with bookings, flight status, cancellations, and emergency support.

twoColumnIntro.title: We're Here to Support Your Family Journey
twoColumnIntro.description: We understand that traveling with children requires extra care and attention. That's why we offer a range of special services and guidance to make your family's journey as smooth and stress-free as possible. From priority boarding to in-flight entertainment, we've got you covered at every step.

twoColumnWithSubSections.title: Creating Meaningful Journeys for Today's Travelers
twoColumnWithSubSections.description: At FlyCham, we believe that every journey should feel personal, seamless, and inspiring. Whether you're traveling for business, leisure, or with family, our mission is to connect people to meaningful destinations through thoughtful service and a human approach.

headerWithThreeImage.title: Fly further with Cham Wings
headerWithThreeImage.description: From takeoff to landing, discover destinations shaped by comfort, culture, and unforgettable views.

itemOne.title: Discover new horizons
itemOne.description: Every route is designed to connect you with places that inspire — from vibrant cities to quiet coastal escapes.

itemTwo.title: Travel with confidence
itemTwo.description: Thoughtful service and carefully planned journeys help you focus on the moments that matter most.

itemOne.title: Towards Our Passengers
itemOne.description: At Cham Wings Airlines, we strive to make every journey more than just a flight. We are dedicated to providing a warm, welcoming atmosphere and exceptional care that makes every passenger feel valued and at ease. From the moment you book until you reach your destination, our commitment is to turn every trip into a memorable experience filled with comfort and hospitality.
itemOne.imageAlt: Young passenger waving onboard an aircraft

itemTwo.title: Towards the Syrian Community
itemTwo.description: As Syria's national airline, Cham Wings carries a responsibility that goes beyond aviation. We are proud to connect Syrians at home and abroad, supporting families, culture, and opportunities through reliable routes and thoughtful service that reflects our shared identity.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Every flight begins with rigorous standards and a culture that puts passenger and crew safety first.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.description: From seating to service, we design journeys that feel calm, spacious, and thoughtfully considered.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.description: Warm Syrian hospitality guides every interaction — onboard, on the ground, and beyond.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Passengers trust us to connect them consistently, with dependable schedules and clear communication.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We pursue continuous improvement in service quality, operations, and the passenger experience.

community.title: Community
community.description: As a national carrier, we stay connected to the people and places that shape our shared journey.

splitWithImage.title: Who We Are
splitWithImage.description: We are a private Syrian commercial airline, established in May 2025 through a strategic partnership with the United Arab Emirates, with an ambitious vision to elevate the aviation sector in Syria and the Middle East. We provide passenger transportation services aboard a modern fleet connecting Syria to regional and international destinations, along with air cargo services that efficiently meet market demands. We believe that flying is not just transportation, but a personal experience that begins the moment you book until the moment you arrive. Every detail reflects the warmth of Syrian hospitality and our constant commitment to exceeding expectations. We are here to bridge distances, connect Syrians with their homeland, and reconnect Syria to the world, guided by an ambitious vision and a deep-rooted tradition in the global aviation sector.

mixedLeftThreeImages.title: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
mixedLeftThreeImages.description: The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is one of the largest mosques in the world, known for its stunning white marble façade, intricate carvings, and magnificent architecture. It stands as a landmark of faith, culture, and craftsmanship — inviting visitors to experience its serene courtyards, luminous interiors, and timeless design.

images.smallOne: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque interior hall
images.smallTwo: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque architectural detail

mixedRightThreeImages.title: Louvre Abu Dhabi
mixedRightThreeImages.description: The Louvre Abu Dhabi is a cultural beacon that blends traditional Arab architecture with contemporary design. Its stunning domed roof, which filters sunlight through intricate patterns, creates a mesmerizing visual experience. The museum's collection spans centuries and continents, featuring art from ancient civilizations to contemporary works. With temporary exhibitions from global collections and educational programs, the Louvre Abu Dhabi is an immersive cultural journey
